summary: Lists trademark credit lines for other common marks such as Linux, UNIX, Microsoft, Apple, Adobe, Macromedia, IBM and Intel, with links to each owner's trademark page.
questions: What credit line should I use when mentioning Windows in docs?

answer_card.title: Other common trademarks
answer_card.answer_md:
- Linux: registered trademark of Linus Torvalds.
- UNIX®: registered trademark of The Open Group.
- Microsoft, Windows, Vista, XP, NT: Microsoft Corporation.
- Apple, Mac, Mac OS, Macintosh: Apple.
- Adobe, Acrobat, PostScript, Photoshop: Adobe Systems.
- IBM: International Business Machines Corporation.
- Pentium, Xeon, Intel Core and similar: Intel Corporation.

Each owner's trademark page is linked in the source.
